domain(person,[khai,petal,daphne,simon]).
% Khai either stays in one city or travels to new places, but not at the same time.
axiom(s1, xor(stays_in_one_city(khai), travels_to_new_places(khai))).
% Khai does not support local businesses.
axiom(s2, not(supports_local_businesses(khai))).
% Khai tends to stay in one city if he has strong community ties.
axiom(s3, rule([has_strong_community_ties(khai)], stays_in_one_city(khai))).
% If Khai likes exotic flavors or craves hearty meals, then he will explore street food.
axiom(s4, rule([or(likes_exotic_flavors(khai), craves_hearty_meals(khai))], explores_street_food(khai))).
% If someone follows food blogs, then they either try Khai's stew or recommend it to friends.
axiom(s5, rule([follows_food_blogs(X)], or(tries_stew(X,khai), recommends_stew_to_friends(X,khai)))).
% If Petal appreciates traditions, then he either loves local food or supports local businesses (or both).
axiom(s6, rule([appreciates_traditions(petal)], or(loves_local_food(petal), supports_local_businesses(petal)))).
% Khai does not have new experiences.
axiom(s7, not(has_new_experiences(khai))).
% Khai does not explore culture.
axiom(s8, not(explores_culture(khai))).
% Khai does not sample regional specialties.
axiom(s9, not(samples_regional_specialties(khai))).
% If someone visits Khai's stall and tries the stew, then they become a regular customer.
axiom(s10, rule([visits_stall(X,khai), tries_stew(X,khai)], becomes_regular_customer(X))).
% Petal either stays in one city or travels to new places, but not at the same time.
axiom(s11, xor(stays_in_one_city(petal), travels_to_new_places(petal))).
% If Khai appreciates traditions, then he either loves local food or supports local businesses (or both).
axiom(s12, rule([appreciates_traditions(khai)], or(loves_local_food(khai), supports_local_businesses(khai)))).
% If Daphne enjoys soups, then he will explore street food and try the stew.
axiom(s13, rule([enjoys_soups(daphne)], and(explores_street_food(daphne), tries_stew(daphne,khai)))).
% Simon does not support local businesses.
axiom(s14, not(supports_local_businesses(simon))).
% If Khai enjoys soups, then he will explore street food and try the stew.
axiom(s15, rule([enjoys_soups(khai)], and(explores_street_food(khai), tries_stew(khai,khai)))).
% Simon does not have new experiences.
axiom(s16, not(has_new_experiences(simon))).
% Petal does not sample regional specialties.
axiom(s17, not(samples_regional_specialties(petal))).
% Daphne enjoys soups.
axiom(s18, enjoys_soups(daphne)).
% If Khai either explores culture or stays in one city (but not both), then he has new experiences.
axiom(s19, rule([xor(explores_culture(khai), stays_in_one_city(khai))], has_new_experiences(khai))).
% If Khai gets bored and seeks adventure, then he travels to new places.
axiom(s20, rule([gets_bored(khai), seeks_adventure(khai)], travels_to_new_places(khai))).
% Anyone who travels to new places will either sample regional specialties or try local cuisine (or both).
axiom(s21, rule([travels_to_new_places(X)], or(samples_regional_specialties(X), tries_local_cuisine(X)))).
% If Khai craves spicy food, then he will venture outdoors and try local cuisine.
axiom(s22, rule([craves_spicy_food(khai)], and(ventures_outdoors(khai), tries_local_cuisine(khai)))).
% Khai appreciates traditions.
axiom(s23, appreciates_traditions(khai)).
% If Khai loves local food, then he will visit his own stall.
axiom(s24, rule([loves_local_food(khai)], visits_stall(khai,khai))).
% Khai enjoys soups.
axiom(s25, enjoys_soups(khai)).
